{{av}}
Allows your dwarves to construct golems, which will join your fortress as citizens. They do not need to eat, drink or sleep, cannot learn most non-military skills, and cannot become nobles. They can, however, join your military and equip weapons and armour. 
They are crafted from 30 metal bars and a large gem by a dwarf with the [[cv:metal crafter|metalcrafting]] labour enabled. Most metal bars can be used, from lead to adamantine. 
This workshop must be built over magma to operate.
